neda: hi all, first-week q: who owns the feature-flag catalogue, API gateway routing rules, and the customer-facing escalation matrix? trying to add a temporary flag for an A/B test and want to file the right change request.

omar: welcome @neda! :wave: Short map: feature-flags -> eng-platform (flags service); gateway/routing -> eng-runtime; escalation matrix (customer contacts + phone) -> people-ops + eng-sre.

neda: thanks 10; where are the canonical files/repos?

omar: feature flags doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/feature-flags. Repo: `platform/flags` (flag definitions in `flags/definitions/`). Gateway routing rules: `gateway/routing` repo. Escalation matrix is in the Ownership Matrix (search "Escalations") and the secure Owners sheet for phone numbers.

lucy: People Ops note: the customer-facing escalation matrix is maintained in People Ops drive (link in the Ownership Matrix). Additions require a short People Ops form so we can sync contact preferences.

neda: do i need approvals to flip a flag in prod for a short A/B run?

omar: yes if the flag targets production. Use the change template in #eng-runtime and include a rollback plan. Minimal ticket to paste: 
```
Change: toggle feature flag
Service: Flags/service-name
Flag: experiment_X_toggle
Environment: prod
Owner: neda
Reason: 2-day A/B test
Rollback: revert flag to previous state
Approver: eng-platform lead
Urgency: low
```

neda: nice. who signs off for updates to the escalation matrix?

lucy: People Ops owns the canonical customer contact list; reach out to @people-ops and cc @eng-sre. For security-controlled phone numbers use the KMS-protected Owners sheet (email security-access@redwood.com to request view).

owner-bot: Current Flags oncall: raj -> teysha. Next rotation 2026-05-01 07:00 UTC. Pager channel: #eng-oncall-flags.

sre-oncall: escalation path for customer-impacting incidents: pager -> oncall -> eng-sre lead -> eng-runtime manager -> customer-success. If SEV1, also page @emergency-ops.

omar: once you have the PR ready, add the filled People Ops form to the PR and ping the oncall owner for ack. If you need help with the ticket wording ping me and I can approve.

neda: perfect, thanks everyone! i'll open the infra ticket and the People Ops form now. :pray:
